{{Short description|95th season of the top-tier football league in Uruguay}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=September 2015}}
Statistics of [[Primera División Uruguaya]] for the 1998 season.

==Overview==
It was contested by 12 teams, and [[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]] won the championship.
